corrections.summary: Fourteen control mappings corrected against the AICPA points of focus. SD-11 Secret scanning leaves CC6.8 (unauthorized or malicious software) for CC6.1 (credentials) and CC7.1 (detecting vulnerabilities introduced by a change). Added: LM-01 CC6.1 (inventory of information assets); NS-05 CC7.2; HR-01 CC1.4 (considers the background of individuals); HR-07 CC1.5; LM-08 CC7.4; EP-02 CC6.1; BC-06 P6.4; CS-03 CC2.3; PE-01 CC9.2; IAM-01, IAM-12, HR-05 CC6.3; IAM-02 CC6.2.

Every mapping now carries coverage (full or partial) and a written rationale, so a criterion's controls can be explained and a supporting control no longer reads as full cover. Every control template now lists the evidence a person or a Verity module provides, marked design or operating. Two controls added for CC8.1: SD-13 Controlled production deployments and SD-14 Change traceability. BC-08 now also maps to P6.4. Rationale, coverage and evidence are Verity authored and unreviewed by a second reviewer (spec CF-3, task A5).

Every control template now carries a Sub-type (sub_category), the finer area inside its Type (category) that the signed spec asks for: 43 areas, 2 to 6 per Type, one per control, derived from each control's name, description and code. This is the one place the vocabulary lives; edit it here, reseal, and run seed-content. PROPOSED: week2-decisions D1 left the Sub-type vocabulary to the client, who has not answered, so these values are Verity authored and unconfirmed.
